fullscreen_tweaks.settings.title: Fullscreen Tweaks
fullscreen_tweaks.settings.subtitle: Window behavior during gameplay and startup
fullscreen_tweaks.tooltip.minecraft_excl: This is Minecraft's regular Exclusive Fullscreen setting.
fullscreen_tweaks.tooltip.prevent_auto_i: Only affects native fullscreen; borderless normally stays visible when unfocused.
When enabled, fullscreen stays visible when Minecraft loses focus.
fullscreen_tweaks.tooltip.fullscreen_mod: Fills the current monitor with an undecorated desktop-sized window.
fullscreen_tweaks.tooltip.loading_screen: Uses the game's saved fullscreen setting while loading.
Keeps the loading screen windowed, regardless of the game setting.
Shows the loading screen fullscreen, regardless of the game setting.
fullscreen_tweaks.tooltip.start_minimize: Keep the window minimized until loading ends.
